In the rendered prose the new flow reads "unless it is waiting on the user. Titles lead with the numbers (issue #4886): ... `PR #<n> status check-in` titles and Routine names are unchanged. A finished stage session is not woken to continue, because the gap between check-ins outlives the prompt cache..." — the "A finished stage session is not woken to" fragment now reads as a continuation of the title-rules paragraph rather than the preceding "unless it is waiting on the user" clause, losing the original "a finished session is not woken up in order to continue" relationship at first read.
  Suggested minimal fix: Either rejoin the original sentence with a semicolon so "unless it is waiting on the user; a finished stage session is not woken to continue..." stays a single clause before the new paragraph, or move the title-rules paragraph to after the trailing "...full price." line.
  Estimated lines changed: 1–2 lines moved or rejoined
